blockers.copy: TruLot needs recorded evidence establishing the legal lot or premises.
TruLot needs a Code-defined regulatory lot or premises area.
TruLot needs authoritative legal boundary geometry and property-line roles.
TruLot needs a current survey tying the building frame to property lines.
TruLot needs a Code-compatible grade and top-elevation analysis.
TruLot needs a reconciled gross-floor-area worksheet and legal premises area.
TruLot needs reviewable parcel-specific slope evidence.
TruLot needs any project-specific Fire Official setback determination.
TruLot has not established the program’s eligibility predicates.
The authoritative source needed for this rule is currently unavailable.
The parcel’s zoning or overlay mapping must be resolved first.
